purpose: Four unique reader illustrations and one separate collection-card illustration for The Birth of Ganesha

assets.brief: Symbolic Kailasa threshold with mouse, modakas, guardian staff, durva and hibiscus; no deity portrait.
Restored elephant-headed young Ganesha reunited with Parvati and Shiva on an imagined Kailasa terrace.
Parvati blesses her newly created human-headed son and gives him garments, ornaments and a staff.
Non-graphic threshold confrontation: the human-headed guardian faces Shiva, Nandi and the ganas.
Non-graphic restoration ceremony: elephant-headed Ganesha awakens as Parvati approaches and sacred water is offered.

conversion: Sharp WebP quality 88, effort 5; 1536 × 1024 output assets
